title: Chapter 394
text:
Fawn Planet 122.

Hu …

An old, small spaceship slowly landed on the devastated, grayish-black land. The airflow from the bottom of the spaceship caused ripples on the ground, and the engine made a buzzing noise. The propulsion system was very simple, and its speed, noise, and shock absorption performance were all very poor. It was a technology that was about to be phased out. In the galactic trade market, only the poor would buy such a simple spaceship.

However, this antique spaceship was equipped with top-notch stealth equipment, such as optical invisibility, sound isolation, gravitational wave penetration, quantum network shielding, and so on. A few Dark-star members disguised as travelers walked down from the spaceship and placed a special signal diffuser on the ground. Invisible radio waves passed through the cracks on the planet's surface at an incredible speed and seeped into the ground.

They went deeper and deeper into the crevices. In a dark, narrow space, a pair of eyes that had been asleep for a long time suddenly opened. There was a faint light on the back of his hand, and there was a microchip implanted in it. It received the signal and made a slight vibration. The vibration occurred in the blood vessels and bones, waking this person up.

"They're finally here."

After a while, the spaceship on the surface finally saw the target appear. A man crawled out from a crack in the distance and walked over slowly. It was Ashes. His face was covered in dust, and his cheeks were thin. He was the only survivor of the Sarota fleet. Before the Dragon Emperor arrived, Sarota had issued the order to retreat, but Ashes knew that the enemy was Ames and knew that the mothership was doomed. He took the risk and chose to stay underground. He went deep into a cave and used his Esper ability to form a piece of carbon to wrap himself up. He then controlled his heartbeat and blood flow to enter a state of suspended animation. As expected, his comrades who had boarded the fleet and retreated were all blown up by the mercenary fleet and the Holy Stone Black Crow. They turned into bright fireworks in space and turned into ashes.

After the destruction of the Sarota fleet, the mercenaries captured Sarota, the highest commander of the mothership, so they did not have the time to search the entire planet for any survivors. This Dark-star fleet was basically wiped out, so there was no need to waste any more time. Ashes survived. Important officers like him had a positioning chip implanted in them. After everyone left the planet, a rescue spaceship came to pick him up.

At that time, Han Xiao was also inclined to believe that Ashes had kicked the bucket, but he still had some doubts in his heart. After all, such a legendary character should not die so easily. However, he also did not have the means to search the entire planet. The other mercenaries were rushing to Godora and would not help him. With just his manpower, who knew how long it would take to search the entire planet? There was no need. Furthermore, in terms of probability, it was not worth it.. Thus, Han Xiao did not investigate. and whether Ashes was dead or alive. or not... Han Xiao Xiao..

A few Dark-star warriors wanted to help him up, but they were all waved away by Ashes. He did not need anyone to help him up. With a cold expression, he said with a deep voice, "Tell me the current situation. Are Sarota and the others all dead?"

"Ames shot down Sarota's mothership. We were attacked by the Holy Stone and Black Crow, and the fleet was completely wiped out. Some of the members on the mothership survived, including Sarota. They were all handed over to Godora by the mercenaries. Colton News reported this a few days ago. They were all sent to the Rainbow Prison."

Every mothership was a mobile base of Dark-star. Losing any one of them was a heavy loss.

Ashes clenched his teeth. "What about the Secret Message Bead?"

"We received rumors that the Secret Message Bead was originally picked up by the Dragon Guards and handed over to the Holy Stone Civilization. They handed it over to Godora."

Ashes' body shook, and he said with a deep voice, "In other words, our sacrifice was meaningless. It was all in vain. How can we let such a huge loss go? Even if we can't beat the Dragon Emperor, we have to make her pay the price. She attacked us to save Black Star, so we have to find a chance to get rid of Black Star and let her know that we're not to be messed with."

At this moment, a voice that was as heavy as a mountain and sonorous and forceful stopped Ashes from speaking.

"At such a crucial time, it's not suitable to provoke a strong enemy. Remember, Godora is the real enemy."

A virtual image appeared in front of Ember. It was a mixed-blood Godoran with pale golden skin. There were some weird scales and wrinkles on his skin, and there was a mysterious pattern on his forehead that extended all the way to his eye bags and nose. It was like the war paint of a barbarian. This person was older, but his eyes were extremely sharp, and his aura was as heavy as a mountain.

As soon as he saw him, the anger in Ashes' eyes disappeared. He lowered his head and said respectfully, "Teacher."

The few Dark-star members beside him also lowered their heads in fear. "Your Excellency Anur."

Anur was the teacher who had unearthed the potential of Ashes' Esper Ability and taught him. He was a high-level officer of Dark-star and one of the few Grade A combatants in the organization. His position was respected, just below the leader.

He looked down at Ashes and said in a deep voice, "I can see that you are angry. Tell me, who made you angry?"

"Black Star. He is a mercenary group leader under the Dragon Emperor. I have lost to him twice, no, three times. Ever since I started working for the organization, I have only lost to him three times. He has humiliated me, and he has a special ability that counters my Esper Ability. Only his death can wash away my humiliation."

Anur interrupted and coldly said, "Childish and narrow-minded. The organization has invested a huge amount of resources into you and groomed you into a powerful warrior. It's not for you to deal with unimportant people. The organization has high hopes for you, and the responsibility you bear is far beyond your imagination. A small mercenary shouldn't be your target, and it's a waste of time to put your eyes on him."

After pausing for a while, he added, "Furthermore, Black Star is a member under the Dragon Emperor. Now is not the time to provoke them. Wait until the big picture is formed, then slowly settle the score."

Ashes lowered his head and asked, "What should I do?"

"Anger has affected your rationality. This is an unforgivable mistake. You are not allowed to go out on missions for a year. Stay in the base and focus on training. Reflect on this properly."

"Understood." Ashes nodded. He respected Anur very much. He calmed down and accepted such an arrangement. His hostility toward Black Star was suppressed to the bottom of his heart. His teacher was right. He was destined to become the trump card of the organization, and he should not waste his energy on unimportant people.

After thinking for a while, Ashes asked one last question. "Teacher, what about the Secret Message Bead?"

"Godora has obtained the Secret Message Bead, and they will know what is inside sooner or later. The seventh generation Mutation Source is in Godora's hands, and there is a risk of the organization's plans being exposed. This matter needs to be discussed at length. In a few days, the leader will hold a meeting to discuss this matter. The future plans will have to be adjusted based on this reason."

After getting the answer, Ashes did not delay any longer. He boarded the spaceship and left.

Juberly Hub …

Ten days passed in the blink of an eye. The players did not have much to do in the stronghold and spent most of their time farming dungeons.

They tried many battles: Power of the Dragon Emperor, exchanging their experiences, and finding a way to clear the stage.

First, they had to choose the Support Team Faction. The countdown was the same as the Dark-star Faction, three hours. Comparing the three, this was the easiest faction. Then, they had to be lucky and meet Goa of the Sky Ring Army in the first twenty minutes. Then, without doing any side missions, they had to follow Goa for two hours and leave before meeting the next wave of enemies that could wipe out the players. This way, they would be able to pass two hours and twenty minutes. The only difficult part was the last forty minutes. If everything went smoothly, there should be six to eight players left. By betraying their teammates one by one, there was a chance that one person would be able to clear the stage. This would cause the reward to decrease by ninety, but at least they would be able to clear the stage.

However, although there was a theoretical method, most of it was based on luck. So far, no one had succeeded.

Originally, these professional players thought that if they chose the Mercenary Faction, they would be able to survive if they met Han Xiao. However, they thought too much. No matter which faction they chose, they would definitely die if they met Han Xiao. The Dark-star Faction was needless to say. If it was the Mercenary Faction or the Support Team, after meeting Han Xiao, they would be able to survive for a long time. However, they would definitely meet Ashes in the end, and everyone would be killed instantly. Even if they left Han Xiao early, they would still meet Ashes.

The professional players shifted their focus to the level 60 Germinal Organization dungeons. The level was suitable, and it was much easier. No matter how high the reward of the level 90 dungeon was, they could only see it but not touch it.

Pork Bun did not manage to record the Dragon Emperor's material, so he could only do a series from before. He recorded the scenes of the level 60 Germinal Organization dungeon and continued the Black Phantom chapter. Coincidentally, this series had not ended yet. The players had only heard of Han Xiao's deeds but had not seen the actual scenes.

Pork Bun's video recorded the progress of the dungeon. The Germinal Organization dungeon was a large-scale team dungeon where Han Xiao infiltrated the Germinal Organization headquarters until the Germinal Organization was finally destroyed. It progressed layer by layer, and it was magnificent.

Pork Bun originally only wanted to use this episode as a transition, but once the video was released, the response was beyond his expectations. The popularity was actually comparable to the Black Star chapter, which surprised him greatly.
